text:
nora_cs: Heads-up on CobaltWave onboarding. Overall good but 95p tails creeping to ~2.2s and token spend ~1.5x forecast. Renewal in 7 weeks. Thinking a low-risk pilot: int8 quant + short-model hop + routing + KV cache. Any red flags?

alin_se: +1. They care about latency first. My suggestion: small-model for <=180 tokens, int8 for mid-length, fp16 for >900 tokens. Start with 2% canary.

paul_ml: did a quick eval on 110 seed prompts. redwood-int8-pro keeps semantic cosine median 0.986; most diffs are minor formatting. Failures concentrated on chained instructions. Recommend semantic gate at 0.98 and A/B comparator.

mike_sre: infra note: tenant on shared-us-east. KV prefix cache should cut tails for repeated templates. Dedicated low-latency pool helps but +12% cost. Hybrid routing seems right. I'll prep canary infra.

sara_pm: add to renewal playbook: 2-slide ROI (est token savings 20-28%, 95p latency down ~18-22%). Add 1-question pulse after pilot: "Was response speed acceptable? (yes / mostly / no)"

# canary routing (alin_se):
```
route: "cobaltwave-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) <= 180 and rand() < 0.02
    target: redwood-small-1
  - condition: tokens(input) > 180 and tokens(input) <= 900 and rand() < 0.02
    target: redwood-int8-pro
  - condition: tokens(input) > 900
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.98
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
  - on_95p_latency_gt: 2000ms
    action: route_to redwood-dedicated-lowlatency
```

mike_sre: ops checklist: provision canary nodes, KV cache toggle, dashboard tiles for semantic_cosine and cache_hit_rate, alerts for semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m) and 95p_latency > 2000ms (15m). I'll create #cs-cobaltwave-alerts.

paul_ml: I'll prepare the eval notebook and automated comparator (diff + cosine) and share prior to canary. Gate: semantic_match >= 0.98 and 95p decrease >= 10% or absolute < 1.6s.

nora_cs: timeline: start canary Mon 09:00 ET for 48h, mid-point sync Tue afternoon, decision Wed morning. I'll send the customer note + enablement invite.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-cobaltwave-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m), 95p_latency > 2000ms (15m). owner: mike_sre.

sara_pm: thanks team. capture results and one-pager for renewal pack if green. :thumbsup:
